text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
"Wah, incredible...! There are race 
photos,\nand group photos with everyone 
too...!\nBrings back so many memories...!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I put a lot of thought into your 
present, you know.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Still, don't the two of us exchange 
souvenirs all the time anyway?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
So Cheval thought something memorable 
would be best. Right?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...! I was, um, just thinking about 
what I'd want to receive...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I thought you might like to see photos 
from races where I gave a great 
performance...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'm super happy! Thank you, 
Kura-chan, Cheval-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Still though... Ahahaha! Did that really 
happen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
We all went to karaoke, got way too hyped, 
and almost dropped the mic—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In the end, Cheval made the catch! Just 
what you'd expect from her dynamic vision♪

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
M-My body just moved on its own, that's 
all... Wait, doesn't my pose look super 
weird here...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, my face looks weird too! Let's take 
more photos like this from now on♪
